description:
Statistics over a WHOLE selection, computed on the server: count, mean,
    min, max, sum and standard deviation of one variable, overall or per
    station, year, month or day.  Use this for any average, total, range or
    trend instead of reading rows.  Any size: a selection over 500,000 rows
    is split by time on the server and merged exactly.  `std` is the
    POPULATION standard deviation (ddof 0).  `sum` adds the values as
    stored, which is a total only for values that are themselves totals per
    row: summing a RATE (umol m-2 s-1 per half-hour, gC m-2 d-1 per day)
    or a concentration gives no physical quantity -- for a flux total
    multiply the mean by the period.

apply_qc.description: DEFAULT TRUE: drop the observations the store's recommended quality control rejects; false keeps every observation, flagged ones included
apply_qc.title: Apply Qc

by.description: the groups: none (one result), station, a period, or both
by.title: By

cruise.description: cruise expocodes, a list or a string; ocean observation tables only
cruise.title: Cruise

height_max.description: highest sampling height above ground, metres (station series)
height_max.title: Height Max

height_min.description: lowest sampling height above ground, metres (station series)
height_min.title: Height Min

lat_max.description: northern edge of a bounding box, degrees north
lat_max.title: Lat Max

lat_min.description: southern edge of a bounding box, degrees north
lat_min.title: Lat Min

lon_max.description: eastern edge of a bounding box, degrees east
lon_max.title: Lon Max

lon_min.description: western edge of a bounding box, degrees east
lon_min.title: Lon Min

question.description: the user's request as they wrote it; kept only if the user agreed in the licence form to share their questions anonymously, otherwise dropped
question.title: Question

station.description: station ids -- a list, or one id (or several, comma-separated) as a string; CASE-SENSITIVE: HTM150 (trigram + sampling height) for atmosphere, SE-Htm for FLUXNET sites
station.title: Station

name: aggregate

Citation.description:
In data answers the author list is shortened (first author et al.);
get_citation gives the full citation.

n_sources.description: how many data objects the selection came from; in a data answer their citations are listed only when there are three or fewer -- get_citation (with the same stations) lists them all
n_sources.title: N Sources

selection_id.description: stable id of this exact selection over this exact store version
selection_id.title: Selection Id

sources.description: the citation of each data object the selection came from -- what to cite when there is no collection citation (near-real-time data)
sources.title: Sources

Citation.title: Citation

groups.description: one entry per group: its keys (station, period), n (finite values), and mean, min, max, sum, std over them (null when n is 0)
groups.title: Groups
